To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the magnetic lime coagation membrane distillation (MLC-MD) integrated system is a promising process for flue gas de-sulfurization wastewater desulfurization, and the membrane foultion is mainly attributed to the scaling, and the colloids, organics and microbe communities are the concrete while the inorganic crystal are the bricks.
a magnetic lime coagulant (MLC) was applied to improve the membrane distillation (MLC MD) performance, and the membrane foultion and wetting were the main issues.
a new MLC-MD integrated process is firstly applied to treat the FGDW, the SS was nearly 99.00 removed and the salt rejection >99.00.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of MLC-MD for FGDW and provides a new way of thinking for the membrane fouling.
the removal of the pollutants and membrane fouling in a MLC MD integrated process for FGDW, which is the first time to be applied in this area.
the application of MLC- MD process to treat FGDW.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MLC MD process is a promising technology to deal with FGDW, and the membrane foultion mechanism of MD process should be further studied.
the MLC MD process can efficiently treat the FGDW with a high flux and a good rejection.
this paper is the first time that MLC MD process is applied for FGDW.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the magnetic coagulation can be used for pretreatment of FGDW to reduce the SS and the MD process can effectively remove the salts, cations, anion, TOC and TIC, but the membrane fouling is inevitable.
the MLC MD integrated process is an excellent method for FGDWs treatment, and the "bricklaying" model can be used to explain the formation of foulants layer.
the MLC- MD process could achieve the FGDW treatment in a short time with high efficiency and low cost.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a new "bricklay ing model" is proposed for the first time to explain the formation mechanism of the foulant layer.
the membrane fouling is mainly caused by the scaling, while the OMs and microbe communities are also important.
the MLC MD process could be a potential method to treat the FGDW with the SS removal and high rejection for salts, cations, anion, TOC and TIC.
